messages:
alex: Hey team, first day here — trying to bootstrap dev env on macOS (Ventura, Apple Silicon). Using brew + asdf + fish + dotfiles. Getting weird behavior: `node` installed via asdf resolves to /usr/local/bin/node sometimes (old intel brew path) and `asdf reshim` doesn't fix it. Any recommended order for PATH or brew installs on arm64?

priya: welcome! :wave: On M1/M2 machines Homebrew default prefix is /opt/homebrew. If you have leftover intel brew in /usr/local it will leak into PATH. Check `which node` and `brew --prefix`. We prepend asdf shims to PATH in fish with `set -Ux PATH ~/.asdf/shims $PATH` so shims win.

alex: ah I had /usr/local earlier in my .zshrc from old dotfiles. I removed it and re-sourced, `node` now points to `~/.asdf/shims/node`. Thanks.

sam: also watch for VS Code using login vs non-login shells — it can mean your updated PATH isn't used. For fish add `source ~/.config/fish/conf.d/asdf.fish` and set VS Code terminal to launch a login shell.

priya: if you installed some packages with the intel brew (Rosetta) they might still be on PATH. Run `arch -arm64 brew install <pkg>` in a native terminal. For global npm installs prefer `npm config set prefix ~/.local` to avoid permission issues.

alex: quick question on dotfiles: I use GNU stow. Is there a recommended repo layout? My stow symlinks conflict with the OS zsh config.

dev-docs: FYI — our dotfiles repo has notes for mac arm in README. We recommend: top-level dirs like `zsh/`, `tmux/`, `bin/` then `stow -t ~ zsh tmux bin`. For mac-specific overrides use `mac/` and source `~/.macrc` from your shell rc.

alex: perfect. last thing: env vars for API keys — should I put them in direnv `.envrc` or use the secrets manager?

priya: during onboarding put non-prod keys in `~/.local/secrets` and `direnv allow` the project `.envrc`. For anything company-managed, use the secrets manager and ask devops for a vault token (ping in #help if you need access).

ops-bot: Reminder: new-hires please confirm "dev env configured" in the onboarding tracker: https://redwood.example.com/onboarding/12345

alex: done, added myself to #infra and will follow the dotfiles README. Thanks everyone!
